name: E2E-AFD-001 — AFD生产回调全流程（成功换图/失败通知/超时降级）
description: 验证F88MaterialProduceMessageListener处理AFD生产回调的三种场景：①成功→裁剪+换图(partEdit)→COMPLETED→通道回写processed ②失败→FAILED标记→钉钉通知买手 ③超时→FAILED标记+生产超时
module: 上游素材生产链路/AFD回调

steps.expression: return (() => { return { testType: 'upstream-rule-validation', scenario: 'AFD生产回调全流程', listener: 'F88MaterialProduceMessageListener', scenarios: [ { name: '成功回调', flow: ['1.收到AFD生产完成MQ消息', '2.解析AfdGenMsgDTO→inputData+outputData', '3.校验生成图URL有效性', '4.按f88Stage区分编辑接口', '5.supplyItemPreAudit→partEditSupplyItemMaterial', '6.platformItemDiagnose→partEditPlatformItemMaterial', '7.换图成功→COMPLETED→通道回写processed→更新预审结果'], expectedResult: 'COMPLETED + 素材已更新' }, { name: '失败回调', flow: ['1.收到AFD生产失败MQ消息', '2.extraInfo.failMsg获取失败原因', '3.更新记录为FAILED', '4.如果是supplyItemPreAudit→更新预审结果为false', '5.换图失败→发送钉钉通知给买手(附带生成图URL)'], expectedResult: 'FAILED + 钉钉通知' }, { name: '超时降级', flow: ['1.收到AFD消息但生产时间超过阈值', '2.判定为生产超时', '3.更新记录为FAILED(failReason=生产超时)', '4.如果是supplyItemPreAudit→更新预审结果'], expectedResult: 'FAILED + 生产超时' }, { name: '写入降级', flow: ['1.MATERIAL_PRODUCE_SKIP_WRITE=true', '2.跳过裁剪和素材更新', '3.更新记录为FAILED(failReason=素材写入已降级)'], expectedResult: 'FAILED + 写入降级' } ] }; })()
steps.description: 定义AFD回调三种场景规则
验证 定义AFD回调三种场景规则 存在

steps.expression: return (() => { return { validation: 'AFD回调规则', checks: [ { name: '成功-供给品', expected: 'partEditSupplyItemMaterial', rule: 'f88Stage=supplyItemPreAudit→供给品编辑接口', pass: true }, { name: '成功-平台品', expected: 'partEditPlatformItemMaterial', rule: 'f88Stage=platformItemDiagnose→平台品编辑接口', pass: true }, { name: '通道回写', expected: 'processed', rule: 'materialChannelStatusWriter.markAfdProcessedSafely', pass: true }, { name: '失败通知', expected: '钉钉通知买手', rule: 'notifyBuyerOnReplaceFailed→附带生成图URL', pass: true }, { name: '超时处理', expected: 'FAILED+生产超时', rule: '生产时间超阈值→标记FAILED', pass: true }, { name: '写入降级', expected: 'FAILED+写入降级', rule: 'MATERIAL_PRODUCE_SKIP_WRITE=true→跳过换图', pass: true }, { name: '链路一通道', expected: '标记劣质图为processing/processed', rule: 'replacePic→imageUrl即劣质图', pass: true }, { name: '链路二通道', expected: '批量标记劣质图', rule: 'generateMaterial→从诊断记录获取所有劣质图URL', pass: true } ] }; })()

_testDesign.preconditions: 已存在EXECUTING状态的GENERATE记录，AFD生产完成并发送回调MQ
_testDesign.stepsText: 1.AFD提交素材生产任务 2.等待生产完成MQ回调 3.成功→验证换图+COMPLETED+通道回写 4.失败→验证FAILED+钉钉通知 5.超时→验证FAILED+生产超时
_testDesign.expectedResult: ①成功：记录COMPLETED，素材已更新，通道processed ②失败：记录FAILED，钉钉通知已发送 ③超时：记录FAILED，failReason=生产超时 ④降级：记录FAILED，failReason=素材写入已降级
_testDesign.dbAssertion: ai_process_record.main_status IN ('COMPLETED','FAILED'); processInfo->>'batchId' IS NOT NULL
riskPoints: 换图接口(partEdit)失败时，记录为FAILED但AFD通道状态可能不一致
钉钉通知发送失败不影响主流程(异步)
链路二需从诊断记录获取劣质图URL列表，refId关联错误会导致通道回写失败
